tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Find trading cards tracked by CardVolume by name, set, number or player. Returns ids, titles, headline market price and record sale. Use get_card with an id for full data.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Full verified data for one card: key facts, market price for each version and grade (median of at least 5 verified sales in 90 days), last and record sale, population, and every verified sale with its source URL. Accepts a CardVolume id, a card URL, or a search query.

tools.name: list_record_sales
tools.description: Highest verified sale for each card, version and grade, largest first, with venue, date and source URL.

tools.name: get_set_checklist
tools.description: Every card in a set (for example the Harry Potter TCG Base Set) with number, type, rarity, holo version and whether two independent sources agree. Call with no arguments to list available sets.
